description: sflow_1d_si_tidal_flat (semi-implicit A 210 13, time steps far above the turbulence time scale, a wetting and drying front) with the depth-averaged k-epsilon model (A 260 1): k and the eddy viscosity stay at the equilibrium of the bed sources (k up to 0.011 m2/s2, eddy viscosity up to 0.024 m2/s at step 400; before: k between -2.6 and 5.8 m2/s2, eddy viscosity up to 0.5 m2/s, and a different flow).
